name: Shandong Oriental Ocean Sci-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Oriental Ocean Sci-Tech Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sea water seedling breeding, aquaculture, aquatic product processing, biotechnology, bonded warehousing, and logistics businesses in China and internationally. The company is involved in the breeding and cultivation of sea cucumbers, kelp seedlings, and precious fish products. It also offers aquatic food deep processing products, such as frozen food, raw food, conditioning, cold-air drying, barbecue, flour-coated, and cooking products; prepared food series, frozen fish fillet series, sea cucumber series processed products, collagen series products; and other series.
